Principal Component Analysis (PCA) reduces correlated features into fewer uncorrelated components while preserving maximum variance.

history.content: What does a CNN pooling layer do?
A pooling layer downsamples feature maps to keep key visual patterns.

question: New topic: what does PCA dimensionality reduction try to preserve?
chosen: PCA reduces many correlated features into fewer uncorrelated principal components while preserving as much variance (information spread) in the data as possible. This simplifies the dataset without losing the most informative patterns.

Overfitting terjadi saat model menghafal noise data latih sehingga performa turun pada data baru, sedangkan underfitting terjadi saat model terlalu sederhana sehingga gagal menangkap pola.
question: Apa perbedaan utama overfitting dan underfitting secara singkat dan akurat?
chosen: Overfitting terjadi ketika model terlalu menghafal data latih beserta noise-nya sehingga hasilnya bagus di data latih tetapi buruk di data baru. Sebaliknya, underfitting terjadi saat model terlalu sederhana sehingga gagal menangkap pola penting bahkan pada data latihnya sendiri.
rejected: Overfitting berarti jumlah data latihnya terlalu banyak sehingga komputer kehabisan RAM, sedangkan underfitting berarti datasetnya kurang dari 100 baris.
